semiconductor_relevance: Low — JPE Yean Hern Corp. primarily focuses on the production of pipe fittings, valves, and related hardware, which are not directly relevant to semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: JPE Yean Hern Corp. specializes in the design and manufacturing of pipe fittings and valves, providing high-quality products and services. While they have a strong presence in the hardware sector, their offerings do not specifically cater to the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, JPE has established itself as a leading company in the hardware industry within the region.
